findings.title: Tool description references an undefined resource
findings.problem: The rag.search description points to a resource, catalog://categories, that is not among the supplied files, so the agent cannot resolve the full category list it is told to use.
findings.proof: Largest categories: toys & games, hobbies, home & kitchen, games & accessories, clothing, shoes & jewelry, costumes & accessories (all of them: resource catalog://categories).
findings.fix: Inline the full category list in the tool description or supply the resource in the context.

findings.title: Catalog price rule repeated across files
findings.problem: The January 2020 catalog price rule is stated in the system prompt and again in the knowledge files, spending tokens twice on the same instruction.
findings.proof: Catalog prices are from a January 2020 snapshot. Call them catalog prices;
findings.fix: Keep one authoritative statement of the price rule and reference it from the other location.

findings.title: Scope file restates the system prompt
findings.problem: scope_and_policy.md largely repeats the operating rules in the system prompt, such as the tool list and the no-action limits, so it adds tokens without adding new grounding.
findings.proof: It has exactly two tools, both read-only searches: `rag.search` over the private catalog and `web.search` over a search API.
findings.fix: Delete the duplicated passages from scope_and_policy.md or remove the file and keep only the unique user-facing scope text.

context_engineering.summary: The context is well-structured, with strong injection, grounding and tool-schema design, but it has undefined rule precedence, unwritten fixed sentences, missing locale, escalation and retention controls, and duplicated text across files that wastes tokens.

metadata.role: voice shopping assistant for product discovery (recommends and compares products; it cannot buy, change or access anything)
metadata.business_case: A shopper speaks or types a request. The assistant searches a private product catalog (rag.search) and a live web search API (web.search) through one MCP server, then answers with a spoken summary of at most 15 seconds and an on-screen comparison table with citations. It has no accounts, no orders, no payments and no personal records; both tools are read-only.
metadata.goal: Recommend up to three products that fit what the shopper asked for, state only what the retrieved evidence states, cite a source for every product, keep the spoken reply short, refuse unsafe requests, and stay within product discovery.
